dataset_metadata.title: Universal Technical & Chart Pattern Empirical Performance Dataset

DOUBLE_BOTTOM_W.optimal_entry: Neckline breakout or 50% retest of second bottom
DOUBLE_BOTTOM_W.best_performing_market: Metals & Mining stocks bouncing off 200 EMA

HEAD_AND_SHOULDERS.optimal_entry: Break and retest of neckline with bearish candle confirmation
HEAD_AND_SHOULDERS.typical_target: Measured vertical distance from head to neckline projected down

INVERSE_HEAD_AND_SHOULDERS.typical_target: Full depth of head projected upward

BULLISH_FLAG_AND_PENNANT.optimal_entry: Break of upper falling trendline channel
BULLISH_FLAG_AND_PENNANT.typical_target: Pole height added to breakout point

BEARISH_FLAG.optimal_entry: Break of ascending flag support line

BULLISH_PINBAR_HAMMER.optimal_entry: Wick rejection at key support or 20/50 EMA
BULLISH_PINBAR_HAMMER.key_trait: Lower shadow at least 2.5x body length

SHOOTING_STAR_BEARISH_PINBAR.optimal_entry: Upper wick rejection at key resistance or VWAP upper band
SHOOTING_STAR_BEARISH_PINBAR.key_trait: Upper shadow at least 2.5x body length

BULLISH_ENGULFING.optimal_entry: Close of green candle that completely engulfs previous red candle body

BEARISH_ENGULFING.optimal_entry: Close of red candle engulfing preceding green candle body

FAIR_VALUE_GAP_FVG_BULLISH.optimal_entry: Limit order at upper edge or 50% Consequent Encroachment of FVG

FAIR_VALUE_GAP_FVG_BEARISH.optimal_entry: Limit order at lower edge or 50% midpoint of bearish gap
FAIR_VALUE_GAP_FVG_BEARISH.best_context: Liquidity sweep of prior swing highs
